text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we begin the meeting?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is right around the
corner. We
haven't any time to spare,
so—
Ho ho ho! Haaaappy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Grass, Grass's trainer! ♪ Havin' a
good
time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who just burst into the
room is
Taiki Shuttle, an American-born
student like
Grass Wonder who happens
to be one of her
Miho dormmates.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki? What's all the commotion
about?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm jus—whoa! No way... Y'all gotta be
kiddin' me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna need both of ya to
gimme a
hand!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? T-to do what?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, Grass! You handle this tinsel! And
Trainer,
you help me over here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No no no! Put it somewhere it's gonna
stand out!
It's gotta bring everything
together with a nice
POP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without the slightest idea what's
happening,
Grass Wonder and I follow
Taiki Shuttle's lead,
until...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... In the blink of an eye, your
office has
become...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Perfect! Thank ya both kindly. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And where's your Kentucky spirit, Grass?
Can't
believe you done almost forgot to
deck the halls!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm not from Kentucky...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can't blame ya, with the Arima
Kinen
comin' up and all. You're probably
dyin' to show
off your skills.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But ya gotta learn to take a load off or
you'll run
yourself into the ground!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Would ya look at that! It's about
time I go hit
the slopes on my sleigh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, let me let y'all go! Have a good
night, ya
hear? ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... J-just look at this room!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I don't think so.
choice_data_list: ……これじゃミーティングは無理か！
……これじゃミーティングは無理だね！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I decide to take
advantage of
the situation and enjoy the
holiday spirit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A whole boxful of chicken... Eheheh...
It's not
quite the same as an American
festive dinner, but
this is special in its
own way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes! ♪
choice_data_list: 冷めないうちに帰って食べよう！

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, I must say, this light display is
gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I thought the strings of
lights
were actual stars that had come
down from the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They're usually way out in space, but I
thought
they made a special trip to see
us for the
holidays.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Getting to touch the stars was a miracle
to me
every December.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I was rather young, mind you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But nowadays... I don't think I need any
miracles,
no matter how distant my goal
may seem.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can climb to any height with my own
two legs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Even the stars are within my reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 貴方なら必ず行けるよ

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Those words are the best present I've
received
this year.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll remember them... to help me when I
reach out
to those stars.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though I do have one worry... Once I
reach those
heights, it may prove
difficult to get back down.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll need some point of reference to
guide my
descent back
home—something bright enough to
see
from the ends of the sky.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer... would you be that light?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! That sounds like an adorable
sight.
choice_data_list: 思いっきり大きく手を振るよ！

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking for you, when that time
comes.
